items.headline: Mamdani faces pressure over NYPD, analysis says

digest.overview:
President Trump gave Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a "Complete and Total Endorsement" nine days before Israel's Oct. 27 election. Vice President JD Vance fielded pointed questions on the Iran war and immigration at a CBS town hall. Trump said he will close a historic Washington golf course for about 15 months of renovations, though a judge has paused redevelopment plans. Kimberly Guilfoyle resigned as ambassador to Greece amid allegations, which she denies, that she sought $100,000 from a donor. Early voting begins Monday in Texas ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms. Super Typhoon Champi passed just south of Guam with 150 mph winds, with no widespread significant damage in early reports, and Norte Fire evacuation orders in Southern California were lifted.

Abroad, four Canadian soldiers were killed and 39 hospitalized after a fire swept a training exercise at CFB Wainwright, as Albertans vote Monday in a non-binding referendum that includes leaving Canada. Putin has proposed a meeting with Trump and Xi Jinping next month on ending the Ukraine war, the Wall Street Journal reported, while Zelenskyy blamed Washington for losing normal access to Starshield satellite service. Egypt's top security body agreed to help Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks. Macron voiced "anger and shame" over rioting during France's protests and announced a crisis unit. China condemned Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's Yasukuni offering, Taiwan drove off 16 Chinese vessels, and South Korea's Rebuilding Korea Party presented an impeachment proposal against Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae. Pope Leo XIV said he will gradually resume duties after surgery, and Hurricane Trudy weakened to Category 1 off Mexico.

home.overview:
The Rays are one win from the World Series after Drew Rasmussen allowed one run over seven innings in a 3–1 Game 5 win at Cleveland for a 3–2 ALCS lead; Game 6 is Monday night in St. Petersburg, and the Brewers host Game 1 on Friday. In the NFL, the Packers beat the Cowboys 23–13 on Sunday night, the Browns edged the Ravens 13–10 to lead the AFC North, the Chiefs dropped the Chargers to 0–6 with a 22–6 win, and the Texans beat the Jaguars 34–31 in London. The Eagles lost a fourth straight, and Commanders–49ers closes Week 6 on Monday night. The NBA opens Tuesday with Celtics–Pistons, 76ers–Knicks and Thunder–Spurs, with the Kings' Ben Simmons out after tearing his Achilles.

Arsenal won 1–0 at Nottingham Forest to cut Man City's lead to three points, Brighton thrashed Crystal Palace 5–0, and Leeds drew 1–1 with Man United. Real Madrid beat Sevilla 4–1 ahead of next Sunday's Clásico at Barcelona, Leverkusen edged Freiburg 2–1, and Lyon top a five-way Ligue 1 logjam after beating Nice. The Champions League returns Tuesday with PSG–Barcelona, and Bayern host Arsenal on Wednesday. FC Seoul can clinch the K League 1 title on Saturday, and Columbus won 2–0 at Cincinnati in MLS. In the KBO, Kia lead LG 2–0 ahead of Tuesday's Game 3 at Jamsil.
